title: Avoid an acknowledged name success followed by a conflict from unrelated session activity
outcome: Naming another held claim reports a consistent outcome when unrelated session activity races the off-lock durable snapshot read.
acceptance: A deterministic regression mutates unrelated session activity during the naming row read and verifies a consistent naming outcome without weakening exact predecessor membership or custody checks.
Any real custody or predecessor-set conflict is reported before a success notice, or explicitly reports which acknowledged state remains and how to retry safely.
